newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, market quiet.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, market quiet.

text.p: Millfeed prices were lightly traded in the Midwest and Plains markets, while Buffalo dealers continued to sell moderate amounts to Canada, millfeed dealers said.
Most of the sales were for April or May shipment. Feed mixers were inquiring for July to September material but flour mills have been reluctant to price feed that far out.
Higher wheat prices after last week's freeze in Kansas, Oklahoma and Texas has millers cautious about pricing flour or millfeeds for summer delivery.
North Texas millfeeds were lightly traded at a steady $97 per ton, but nearly all the sales were for delivery next week.
A $3-per-ton drop in offers for millfeeds delivered to the western Carolinas may induce feed mixer buying, but as of this morning demand was light.
"There hasn't been any business today, but I think there will be at these price levels," a Carolina dealer said.
